sv.title: Le Pens vallöfte: Stoppa stödet till Ukraina
sv.summary: Franska ytterhögerns presidentkandidat Marine Le Pen lovar att sluta ge ekonomiskt stöd till Ukraina om hon vinner valet nästa år.

en.title: Le Pen's election pledge: Stop support for Ukraine
en.summary: French far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen promises to stop giving financial support to Ukraine if she wins the election next year.
